subject.title: [Feature]: Config IO silently swallows errors that may indicate serious problems

question: Should this issue be scoped to targeted operator-visible logging for actionable config IO persistence failures, or should it also add retry and strict-failure semantics?
rationale: The remaining source-reproducible problem is real, but AGENTS.md treats config surfaces and fallback behavior as compatibility-sensitive, and the open fix PR covers logging while the issue also proposes retry and a strict config flag.

options.title: Scope to targeted logging
options.body: Land or replace the open PR with focused warning/error logs for audit and backup persistence failures while preserving current non-fatal best-effort semantics.

options.title: Define retry or strict mode
options.body: Specify the operator-facing retry or strict-mode behavior, upgrade expectations, and tests before implementation because this changes config IO failure semantics.

options.title: Defer broad cleanup
options.body: Keep the partial health and restore fixes only, and close or retarget the open PR if maintainers decide the remaining best-effort silence is intentional.

recommendation.title: Scope to targeted logging
recommendation.body: Land or replace the open PR with focused warning/error logs for audit and backup persistence failures while preserving current non-fatal best-effort semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The config IO history points most strongly to steipete for the remaining audit/recovery/fallback boundary decision.
